subject: Marketplace vendor onboarding: PO timelines, regional billing & evidence escrow
messages:
From: Emily Chung <emily.chung@atlasware.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor onboarding questions + PO cadence for AtlasWare

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday — AtlasWare is excited to list on Redwood's marketplace. Before we start the listing intake forms, procurement here needs clarity on a few items to align legal and finance: 

- Which legal entity will AtlasWare contract with for the AWS/Azure/GCP listings (we operate EU and US subsidiaries)?
- What is Redwood's typical PO acceptance window (how long before a PO is considered valid for billing start)?
- Do you accept consolidated monthly invoices for multiple marketplace listings, or does each listing require its own PO/invoice?
- For EU customers we may need to escrow some evidence. Can you confirm what evidence (SOC 2, encryption key controls, data residency attestations) is required during onboarding vs post-go-live?

Attached: atlasware_vendor_forms_v1.pdf (initial intake). Can you please loop in whoever owns marketplace billing?

Best,
Emily Chung
Procurement Lead, AtlasWare
attachments: atlasware_vendor_forms_v1.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chung <emily.chung@atlasware.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-04-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questions + PO cadence for AtlasWare

Emily — thanks for sending this. Looping in Vanessa (marketplace ops / billing) and Kimberly (procurement intake) to answer the details below. High-level answers first so you have something to share with legal/finance: 

- Contract entity: we operate two invoicing entities (Redwood Inference, Inc. for US and Redwood Inference EU Ltd. for EU listings). We will provide a short form that documents which entity will be used per marketplace/region.
- PO acceptance window: once signed by both parties and returned via DocuSign to procurement@redwoodinference.com, we treat the PO as effective on the stated start date. If no start date, the invoice period begins on the first day of the month following PO acceptance.
- Invoicing: we can accept consolidated monthly invoices across multiple listings if you assign a single billing reference; otherwise we issue per-listing invoice stubs.
- Evidence: SOC 2 and basic encryption controls summary are required during intake; deeper artifacts (full reports, control narratives) can be provided during the pre-go-live security review. For EU VAT/escrow requests we have a short escrow checklist we can share.

I'll have Vanessa attach the standard PO template and the SOC2 snapshot.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Marketplace Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chung <emily.chung@atlasware.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-04-22T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questions + PO cadence for AtlasWare

Hi Emily — quick note with the attachments and a proposed timeline. Attached: SOC2-snapshot-2024.xlsx, PO_Template_Redwood.docx. See proposed onboarding milestones below: 

1) Intake forms returned + SOC 2 snapshot — 3 business days after receipt
2) PO signed via DocuSign — target 7 business days (we can accelerate if legal signs off quickly)
3) Marketplace listing review & preflight — 5 business days after signed PO and evidence
4) Go-live window — typically within 10 business days after preflight if no exceptions

A few process notes: 
- For AWS Marketplace we require the PO to reference the AWS listing SKU; for Azure/GCP we map to our internal product codes (we'll provide mapping).
- VAT handling: for EU entities we can accept local-entity invoicing but require VAT registration number up front.
- Escrow/evidence: if your legal requests an escrow of certain evidence, we accept a sealed evidence binder (S3 presigned with restricted access) — we will provide the upload instructions during intake.

Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: SOC2-snapshot-2024.xlsx, PO_Template_Redwood.docx
From: Emily Chung <emily.chung@atlasware.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@atlasware.com>
Date: 2025-04-23T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questions + PO cadence for AtlasWare

Thanks Vanessa — those timelines are helpful. A couple of follow-ups from legal/finance after reviewing the PO template: 

- Legal asks for a clause clarifying the refund/credits policy if a listing is delisted for policy reasons within 30 days. Can Redwood provide the marketplace delist policy snippet to include as an addendum?
- Finance wants the invoice to include line-item unit prices and an aggregated monthly total for consolidated billing. Is that supported?
- Raj (cc'd) requests the escrow approach in writing — specifically: who will hold the evidence (Redwood infra), retention period, and access controls for the presigned S3 object.

We'll return the intake form and a draft PO next week.

Emily
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chung <emily.chung@atlasware.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-04-24T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questions + PO cadence for AtlasWare

Emily / Raj — answer below inline for your counsel/finance team.

- Delist refunds/credits: Redwood's standard marketplace terms state that if a listing is removed for verified policy violations within 30 days of go-live, we will issue pro-rated credits for unused committed amounts. We will send the contractual snippet for your addendum (attached as a one-pager).
- Invoice format: yes — we support line-item unit prices plus an aggregated monthly summary on the invoice. We'll add the exact column layout sample to the intake packet.
- Escrow/evidence handling: Redwood will host the evidence in a restricted S3 bucket managed by our security team; access is by time-bound presigned URLs shared with named contacts. Retention: default 12 months after onboarding unless otherwise requested. Access controls: KMS-encrypted at rest, IAM-limited to Redwood procurement & named vendor contacts. We will produce a short evidence-handling statement you can attach to your PO.

Attaching: marketplace_delist_policy_snippet.pdf, invoice_sample_layout.csv, evidence_handling_statement.pdf

Kimberly Park
Head of Procurement Intake
Redwood Inference
attachments: marketplace_delist_policy_snippet.pdf, invoice_sample_layout.csv, evidence_handling_statement.pdf
From: Emily Chung <emily.chung@atlasware.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-04-25T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questions + PO cadence for AtlasWare

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Raj and finance are satisfied with the wording and the evidence-handling statement. We've uploaded the completed intake form and the signed PO (DocuSign link below) — PO references Redwood Inference EU Ltd. for EU listings and Redwood Inference, Inc. for US. Looking to finalize mapping to AWS SKU and confirm the preflight date next week.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/sign?doc=po-DW-4821-AW (signed)
Intake upload: https://drive.atlasware.com/shared/atlasware_vendor_forms_v1_filled.pdf

Thanks,
Emily
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chung <emily.chung@atlasware.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-04-25T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding questions + PO cadence for AtlasWare

Perfect — thanks Emily and team. Vanessa and I will schedule the preflight for 2025-04-29 and send the SKU mapping by end of day tomorrow. I'll add the HubSpot deal link to the intake record so customer success gets notified.

Jordan
